structural_change: s81sl_xrt3u (STW-S81e-XR 10-23, MAIN; COORD review 10-23: xrt3t/xrt3t_b failed 6x, ECO TT -15 / FF -10, worst TT bsw_c -> body mux -> c_d 574 um Manhattan (select at x 390, c_d at the W-face SW corner), rwb -> sw_d row write 424 um with logic, lo_sel -> pk 357 um (placement reg->reg -41): logic hops spanning the pin-bound 570x395 outline.  Structural: (1) W-face CTL-body copy (RTL OT_S81SL_XR_BW: ebw/wbw/vbw + bsew_c/bsww_c kept, same D, 0 cycles) for the sw_d row write; (2) register floorplan: the copies anchored FIRM pre-GPL in a box beside sw_d (reg_floorplan_place.tcl), so the long hop is the zero-logic pin-flop -> copy wire (<= ~440 um) and the select hop <= ~310 um; (3) consumer-adjacent pin plan: c_v/c_d W -> N beside is_d/cfg_d (all three body copies on one face), S face reordered bi | eg/x/rb/p | lo_d | bo (bi beside the RD unpackers, lo_d beside pk -> ci_b/bo); same bits per face except c_d (N 3.3/um, W 4.8/um); (4) k-means CTS K=32 (xrt3t_b: TT/FF spread 43.9/35.7).
